title: CODA-A: Residuals of Projections, Kernels, and Cokernels — The Anomalon as a Typed Leftover
description: CODA-A proves algebraic residual identities for projections and commuting maps. The Lean model uses additive groups; its quotient universal property establishes the unique underlying function, with scalar linearity proved in prose and checked in rational matrix examples. A-T8 is a declared commitment. A-T9 is restricted to finite rational coordinate spaces with the coordinate l1 norm and equal projection/repair images. Python implements exact rational residuals and a five-case finite cochain classifier. Residuals do not supply authority or causal provenance. The toy existence witness is internal to the finite taxonomy.
